calculation.description: At each date, oppose each instrument's trailing 10-session return relative to the cross-sectional median, scaling the reversal score by its trailing 40-session return volatility. The signal is lagged one completed session before forward-return evaluation or use.

validation.regime_notes: Passes the benchmark absolute IC and ICIR gates over 1,293 daily cross-sectional observations. Predictive strength is positive and stronger in recent 365-, 730-, and 1,095-session windows, with approximately full valid cross-section after warm-up; uncertainty remains material because the universe has only 15 instruments.
validation.validation_method: Daily Spearman cross-sectional IC between lagged factor and forward close-to-close returns; observations require at least 8 valid instruments. Library correlation was not computed in this cycle and must be recomputed from signal artifacts by the deterministic post-Miner gate.
